motion.name: control-color
motion.purpose: Control state changes; removed under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: press
motion.purpose: Immediate enabled-button press feedback; not an animation.

components.name: Primary Button
components.css: .ds-button-primary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:42px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:999px;padding:10px 18px;font:500 13px/1.4 Inter,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms,color 150ms,border-color 150ms;background:var(--action, oklch(0.55 0.21 264));color:oklch(0.985 0.01 264);}.ds-button-primary:hover{background:color-mix(in oklch, var(--action, oklch(0.55 0.21 264)), black 12%);color:oklch(0.985 0.01 264);}.ds-button-primary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary, oklch(0.62 0.21 264));outline-offset:3px;}.ds-button-primary:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(1px);}.ds-button-primary:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:wait;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-primary{transition:none;}}

components.name: Secondary Button
components.css: .ds-button-secondary{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:42px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:999px;padding:10px 18px;font:500 13px/1.4 Inter,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms,color 150ms,border-color 150ms;background:transparent;color:var(--fg, oklch(0.985 0.01 264));border-color:var(--border, oklch(0.32 0.03 264));}.ds-button-secondary:hover{background:var(--secondary, oklch(0.27 0.03 264));color:var(--fg, oklch(0.985 0.01 264));}.ds-button-secondary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary, oklch(0.62 0.21 264));outline-offset:3px;}.ds-button-secondary:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(1px);}.ds-button-secondary:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:wait;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-secondary{transition:none;}}

components.name: Ghost Button
components.css: .ds-button-ghost{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:42px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:999px;padding:10px 18px;font:500 13px/1.4 Inter,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms,color 150ms,border-color 150ms;background:transparent;color:var(--muted, oklch(0.708 0.02 264));}.ds-button-ghost:hover{background:var(--secondary, oklch(0.27 0.03 264));color:var(--fg, oklch(0.985 0.01 264));}.ds-button-ghost:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary, oklch(0.62 0.21 264));outline-offset:3px;}.ds-button-ghost:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(1px);}.ds-button-ghost:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:wait;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-ghost{transition:none;}}

components.name: Destructive Button
components.css: .ds-button-destructive{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;min-height:42px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:999px;padding:10px 18px;font:500 13px/1.4 Inter,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms,color 150ms,border-color 150ms;background:color-mix(in oklch, var(--error, oklch(0.704 0.191 22.216)), transparent 88%);color:var(--error, oklch(0.704 0.191 22.216));}.ds-button-destructive:hover{background:color-mix(in oklch, var(--error, oklch(0.704 0.191 22.216)), transparent 78%);color:var(--error, oklch(0.704 0.191 22.216));}.ds-button-destructive:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary, oklch(0.62 0.21 264));outline-offset:3px;}.ds-button-destructive:active:not(:disabled){transform:translateY(1px);}.ds-button-destructive:disabled{opacity:.5;cursor:wait;}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-button-destructive{transition:none;}}

components.name: Labeled Field
components.css: .ds-field{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:8px;color:var(--fg, oklch(0.985 0.01 264));font:500 12px/1.5 Inter,sans-serif;}.ds-input{width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:44px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:24px;padding:11px 16px;background:color-mix(in oklch, var(--input, oklch(0.36 0.03 264)), transparent 50%);color:var(--fg, oklch(0.985 0.01 264));font:400 14px/1.5 Inter,sans-serif;caret-color:var(--primary, oklch(0.62 0.21 264));transition:background-color 150ms,border-color 150ms;}.ds-input:hover{background:color-mix(in oklch, var(--input, oklch(0.36 0.03 264)), transparent 35%);}.ds-input:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary, oklch(0.62 0.21 264));outline-offset:3px;}.ds-input::placeholder{color:var(--muted, oklch(0.708 0.02 264));}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-input{transition:none;}}

components.name: Wallet Navigation
components.description: Three destinations with a selected tonal pill.
components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;gap:4px;padding:8px 12px 12px;background:var(--bg, oklch(0.145 0.015 264));}.ds-nav button{flex:1;min-height:40px;padding:10px 6px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:999px;background:transparent;color:var(--muted, oklch(0.708 0.02 264));font:500 11px/1.4 Inter,sans-serif;cursor:pointer;transition:background-color 150ms,color 150ms;}.ds-nav button:hover{background:color-mix(in oklch, var(--secondary, oklch(0.27 0.03 264)), transparent 60%);color:var(--fg, oklch(0.985 0.01 264));}.ds-nav button[aria-current]{background:var(--secondary, oklch(0.27 0.03 264));color:var(--fg, oklch(0.985 0.01 264));}.ds-nav button:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--primary, oklch(0.62 0.21 264));outline-offset:3px;}.ds-nav button:active{transform:translateY(1px);}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-nav button{transition:none;}}

components.name: Balance Surface
components.description: Portfolio-inspired spendable balance surface; illustrative content only.
components.html:
Spendable balance

—PRL

Reading your addresses…
components.css: .ds-balance{border:1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.32 0.03 264));border-radius:26px;overflow:hidden;background:color-mix(in oklch, var(--surface, oklch(0.205 0.02 264)), transparent 25%);color:var(--fg, oklch(0.985 0.01 264));font:400 12px/1.5 Inter,sans-serif;}.ds-balance-content{padding:16px 20px 20px;background:linear-gradient(125deg,transparent,color-mix(in oklch, var(--secondary, oklch(0.27 0.03 264)), transparent 45%) 55%,color-mix(in oklch, var(--primary, oklch(0.62 0.21 264)), transparent 76%));}.ds-balance-content>span{color:var(--muted, oklch(0.708 0.02 264));}.ds-balance p{margin:12px 0 0;font:500 36px/1.35 "JetBrains Mono",monospace;letter-spacing:-.03em;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;}.ds-balance small{margin-left:10px;color:var(--muted, oklch(0.708 0.02 264));font:400 16px/1.35 Inter,sans-serif;letter-spacing:0;}.ds-balance-status{padding:10px 20px;color:var(--muted, oklch(0.708 0.02 264));font-size:10px;}

components.name: Setup Progress
components.description: Current and pending steps of the guided task.
components.css: .ds-progress{display:flex;list-style:none;padding:0;margin:0;gap:8px;color:var(--muted, oklch(0.708 0.02 264));font:400 10px/1.5 Inter,sans-serif;}.ds-progress li{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;flex:1;}.ds-progress li>span{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid var(--border, oklch(0.32 0.03 264));font-size:9px;}.ds-progress [aria-current]{color:var(--fg, oklch(0.985 0.01 264));}.ds-progress [aria-current]>span{background:var(--action, oklch(0.55 0.21 264));border-color:var(--action, oklch(0.55 0.21 264));color:white;}

components.name: Recovery Word
components.description: Masked numbered recovery entry with parent focus and invalid state.
components.css: .ds-word{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:5px;border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:12px;background:color-mix(in oklch, var(--input, oklch(0.36 0.03 264)), transparent 50%);padding:0 8px;min-width:0;}.ds-word>span{font:400 8px/1.5 "JetBrains Mono",monospace;color:var(--muted, oklch(0.708 0.02 264));min-width:10px;}.ds-word>input{width:100%;min-width:0;min-height:38px;padding:7px 0;background:transparent;border:0;border-radius:0;color:var(--fg, oklch(0.985 0.01 264));font:400 11px/1.5 Inter,sans-serif;caret-color:var(--primary, oklch(0.62 0.21 264));}.ds-word>input::placeholder{color:var(--muted, oklch(0.708 0.02 264));}.ds-word>input:focus-visible{outline:none;}.ds-word:has(input:focus-visible){outline:2px solid var(--primary, oklch(0.62 0.21 264));outline-offset:2px;}.ds-word:has(input[aria-invalid="true"]){border-color:var(--error, oklch(0.704 0.191 22.216));}

narrative.overview:
The visual authority is Abyss's established app: its wordmark, blue, Inter and JetBrains Mono, rounded tonal surfaces, pill controls and restrained dot field. This extension adapts that identity to a compact financial task. Inter is an intentional incumbent choice, retained from the user-pinned product.

The interface is calm and compact. Amounts, account identity and the current task have priority; helper text and secondary actions recede. The early-alpha label stays visible without becoming the dominant color. The full-page background supplies atmosphere while the wallet surface remains stable and readable.
keyCharacteristics: Established Abyss wordmarks and self-hosted type.
Rounded tonal surfaces with restrained borders.
Monospaced financial data and explicit state labels.
Persistent task actions with a separately scrolling body.

rules.name: Brand and Action
rules.body: Keep the established primary blue for brand, focus and selection. Use the darker action fill for white button labels and the current setup step.

rules.name: Data Before Decoration
rules.body: Use JetBrains Mono for balances, amounts and addresses; retain Inter for instructions and action labels.

rules.name: Tonal Depth
rules.body: Separate surfaces with tonal fills and subtle borders. Preserve the balance gradient and full-page dot field; controls and panels do not cast decorative shadows.

dos: Do preserve the actual Abyss wordmarks, self-hosted fonts and single Phosphor icon family.
Do use action fill for white primary labels and keep keyboard focus visible.
Do keep account, network and requesting origin clear during approval.
Do show unavailable funds as unavailable and preserve pending, reserved and spendable distinctions.
Do verify compact and full-page layouts in both themes and honor reduced motion.
donts: Don't replace the established identity with a palette-only approximation.
Don't add promotional eyebrows, decorative display type or generic security slogans.
Don't wrap every field in a decorative card or add control glows and panel shadows.
Don't fabricate activity, prices or balances, or hide complete addresses where users need to verify them.
